notes.amasiro: Lyel is a grave; luker are the rulers.

guidebook.intro: Learn about the Kabaka and the kingdom of Buganda. The Luganda titles stay as they are; the Acholi words around them are new.

tips.title: Ker: rule, kingdom
body: **Ker** is a kingdom or the power to rule, and **loyo** is to rule (or to win): **Kabaka loyo Buganda**. **Gang ker** (the home of rule) is a palace.
**Kwo mabor!** (live long!) is how you answer **Kabaka awangaale!**

tips.title: Titles
body: **Kabaka** (king), **Nnaabagereka** (queen), **Katikkiro** (prime minister) and **Lukiiko** (parliament) are kept in Luganda, as Acholi speakers say them.

culture.title: Ker Kwaro Acholi
body: Acholi land has its own cultural institution, **Ker Kwaro Acholi** (the rule of the ancestors), led by the **Lawi Rwodi**, the chief of chiefs, elected from among the Rwodi.
